title: Strong Colouring of the Qualitative Independence Hypergraph $3\text{-}QI(11,2)$
summary: We determine the strong independence number of the qualitative independence hypergraph, $3\text{-}QI(11, 2)$, using a technique that involves considering its vertices as subsets of $\{1,2, \ldots, 11\}$ and assessing them as intersecting set systems. This gives the maximum size of colour classes in any strong colouring and thus, a lower bound on the strong chromatic number of $3\text{-}QI(11,2)$.
